description: Header file defining the AddressSorterPosix class for DNS address sorting on POSIX systems, including policy structures, address scope enums, and observer mechanisms.

classes.name: AddressSorterPosix
classes.description: Implements DNS address sorting policy for POSIX systems, not thread-safe, uses explicit policy, observes network address changes.

methods.name: Sort
methods.description: Sorts a list of IP endpoints based on policy and network conditions, asynchronously.

methods.name: OnIPAddressChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the IP address changes, updates internal address source info.

methods.name: FillPolicy
methods.description: Fills address source info based on policy tables for a given IP address.

methods.name: FinishedSort
methods.description: Completes the sorting process for a given sort context.
